content: Transcriptional-regulating factor 1 (TRERF1) is a protein encoded by the TRERF1 gene in humans. This protein functions as a zinc-finger transcriptional regulator. It plays a role in modulating the expression of the human CYP11A1 gene by interacting with coactivators CBP (CREB-binding protein) and p300. TRERF1 has been demonstrated to interact with several key proteins, including Steroidogenic Factor 1 (SF-1), EP300 (E1A binding protein p300), and CREB-binding protein (CBP). These interactions suggest its involvement in transcriptional regulation processes, particularly in pathways related to steroidogenesis.
